mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and employment growth (PAYEMS < 100k) signals broad economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) during monetary tightening cycles signals imminent rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC for regime-conditional signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1400 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which reduces overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1400, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC for regime-conditional signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized) signals stagflationary risks that trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
